blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Makati City Regional Trial Court (RTC) has issued an arrest warrant for extradition and a hold departure order against detained Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) leader Pastor Apollo Carreon Quiboloy and two of his associates, acting on a formal extradition petition filed on behalf of the United States government.
